name: WhatsApp Business
showcaseSub: Sandbox gateway: nothing is sent to real customers.
gate: Needs Meta business verification and template approval for live
sandboxHowTo: Use Meta's test business number and add up to 5 test recipients in the Meta app dashboard. Messages to anyone else are refused by Meta.
pricingNote: Meta bills WhatsApp per message, by template category (marketing, utility, authentication, service). Free-form replies inside the 24-hour window follow Meta's current service-message rules. Check Meta's published rates; this system shows no prices.
connectManualHelp: Paste the WhatsApp Business Account ID, the phone number ID, a system user access token and the Meta app secret. They are stored encrypted and never shown again.
webhookHelp: Paste this URL and your verify token into the Meta app's WhatsApp webhook settings, and subscribe to messages and message template status updates.
templatesNone: No templates yet. Create and submit them in Meta Business Manager; approved ones appear here after the next sync.
block.no_lead: Not sent: link this conversation to a lead first.
block.no_consent: Not sent: this person has no WhatsApp consent on record, or has opted out.
block.no_recipient: Not sent: there is no phone number for this conversation.
block.template_not_approved: Not sent: the template is not approved.
block.template_params: Not sent: the message does not match its template.
block.text_too_long: Not sent: the message is too long for WhatsApp.
block.window_closed: Waiting for a template: the 24-hour window has closed, only an approved template can be sent.
fail.window_closed: Meta refused the message: the 24-hour window has closed. Send an approved template.
fail.recipient_not_allowed: Meta refused the message: this number is not on the sandbox test recipient list.
fail.invalid_recipient: Meta could not deliver to this number.
fail.user_limit: Meta limited messages to this person for now.
fail.template: Meta refused the template message. Check the template and its variables.
fail.account: The WhatsApp account has a problem. Check it in Meta Business Manager.
optout.logged: The customer opted out of WhatsApp. No further messages will be sent.
numberTaken: This WhatsApp number is already connected to another workspace.
